consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the 1976-08-02 show at Colt Park was a memorable experience with high energy and strong performances, particularly in the second set. While some noted issues with crowd noise and tape quality, many praised the band's tightness and the overall vibe of the concert.
rating_rationale: 2.5 base + 0.3 for 41 reviews + 0.5 sentiment: While many fans had a great time and highlighted standout performances, there were also criticisms regarding the overall energy and some crowd-related distractions.
